title: SAP Document AI: Beyond OCR — What a Two-Invoice POC Proved
subtitle: Two synthetic invoice exports, scoped field accuracy, source-support gaps and untested Finance integration
evidence_status: Owner-supplied manual extraction exports reconciled offline; no independent live tenant read or Finance execution
lineage_note: Public projection of a bounded two-invoice synthetic exercise. Source data came from owner-supplied SAP Document AI exports and PDFs; no live SAP API/catalog read was performed for this publication review. SAP Finance Phase 2 is deferred because an authorized Finance test environment was not available.

sections.title: Why evaluate SAP Document AI if OCR exists?
sections.markdown:
**Research question:** What does intelligent document processing add beyond recognizing invoice text? The SAP Document AI exercise produced structured invoice header and line-item values from two supplied synthetic documents. Basic OCR concerns text recognition; using document fields in business processes requires interpretation and validation. **This exercise did not test any other OCR or IDP platform**, so it cannot establish a product advantage or a productivity benefit.

The architecture question is whether extracted values are supported by the original source and can be controlled before downstream business use.

sections.title: Two synthetic invoice documents
sections.markdown:
The owner supplied two synthetic supplier-invoice PDFs and case-labeled SAP Document AI extraction exports. The two invoices shared business identity and amounts but were different PDF files. An offline, field-by-field comparison reconciled the selected expected values to the printed source content. This was **not** a fresh authenticated tenant/API read in the publication review.

| Evidence | Scoped result |
| --- | --- |
| Expected header fields | 9 per invoice matched |
| Expected line-item fields | 8 per invoice matched |
| All selected expected fields | **34/34 matched** (17 per invoice) |
| Supplier-address outputs without source support | **12**, six per invoice |
| Complete current tenant catalog inventory | **Not established** |
| SAP Finance duplicate handling / posting | **Not tested** |

These results describe **two synthetic documents and only 34 selected fields**. They are not an overall extraction accuracy rate, a live processing-status claim or an enterprise Accounts Payable qualification.

sections.title: Why populated address fields cannot be trusted automatically
sections.markdown:
The owner-supplied exports contained six address-designated values per invoice that were not supported as supplier-address facts by the source PDFs. For example, a currency token appeared in a city field. **These 12 unsupported values were identified during offline review**; the study did not demonstrate a technical control preventing their downstream transfer.

**Proposed control, not an implemented outcome:** validate each extracted field against source evidence and authoritative reference data, then reject or quarantine unsupported values before any Finance integration. No downstream FI update, master-data write or quarantine mechanism was exercised.

sections.title: Five distinct architecture boundaries
sections.markdown:
**Proposed architecture for a future controlled integration (not implemented in KS05):**

1. **Extract** structured header and line-item values from incoming invoices.
2. **Validate** mandatory fields, arithmetic and support in the original document.
3. **Resolve business identity** using authorized supplier and purchasing reference data when available.
4. **Apply business controls** in the actual target invoice-management or Finance system.
5. **Authorize downstream activity** separately, including drafts, postings and payments.

KS05 demonstrated a bounded extraction output and offline comparison of selected fields only. It did **not** demonstrate connected supplier master data, validation enforcement, duplicate rejection or Finance transactions.

sections.title: Compared with OCR and other IDP services
sections.markdown:
This was **not a comparative product evaluation**. The POC did not execute a traditional OCR engine or any competing intelligent document processing platform. It therefore does not support claims that SAP Document AI is more accurate, faster, less expensive or uniquely capable.

For a future comparative study, use the same documents and scoring contract to measure extraction errors, unsupported values, manual correction time, workflow compatibility and total cost per validated invoice. No future integration option is presented here as a proven capability of the current project.

sections.title: What the evidence does not establish
sections.markdown:
- **Current tenant inventory/status:** no authenticated fresh full-catalog read was available for this publication review.
- **SAP Finance validation:** no target supplier master, company-code configuration or FI/MM runtime duplicate check was tested.
- **Downstream controls:** no enforced source-field quarantine, draft creation, posting or payment was demonstrated.
- **Competitive value:** no OCR/IDP comparator, representative sample, production workload or business cost benchmark was run.
- **Evidence provenance:** owner-supplied manual exports were reviewed offline; this is not independent live SAP readback.

Finance integration Phase 2 is **deferred** because an authorized SAP Finance test environment was unavailable to this evaluation. Deferral does not establish either a SAP Document AI defect or end-to-end product fitness.

sections.title: Decision and learning
sections.markdown:
**Decision:** Retain KS05 as a bounded, synthetic document-extraction observation, not a demonstration of complete AP automation.

Two files can show how fields are represented and where unsupported data appears, but they cannot establish general accuracy, downstream business controls or comparative value. Future value qualification would require authorized source/master data, evidence-backed field validation and a separate Finance system; that work is deferred.

**Community discussion:** What evidence would you require before accepting AI-extracted invoice values for use in Finance?

sections.title: Official SAP reference material
sections.markdown: The referenced SAP documentation provides product and catalog API background only. Documentation is **not evidence that a specific live tenant operation was executed**. The supplied synthetic invoice observations and the absent Finance test are separately bounded above.
